name: @dsh-external/dsh-sec-enforce
description: DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the pentest / code-audit presets: ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the two security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md. Reversible-but-invasive classes (account/privilege changes, firewall rule edits, flood stress) route through the tools/pre-execute waterfall into the host approval service (allowed-once or deny) instead of a hard block. Open intents block report writes until closed (intentGate, default on). constraintGate: keyword-bearing deny constraints from the task ledger intercept matching bash commands and fetch URLs, citing the constraint text.
author: Saker contributors
